title: Validate a request: notice an error before accepting a write
goal: Check required fields and duration, correct a rejected new request and verify persistence by reopening it.

prerequisites.text: 1c-enterprise.a 2; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.

sections.title: From a familiar situation to a checkable question
paragraphs: You clicked Save, but no number appeared. This need not mean data loss: the form may correctly refuse a save. Identify the field that violates the rule and the observation that establishes a repair. Work through 30 minutes, then save 25 in a new task without replacing another request.

sections.title: Where to act
paragraphs: Work in the installed training service. Nexus stores the lesson and your note, but does not change the external infobase. Give report control its own separate practice with the four specified requests; 0/1440 probes and earlier 20/55 must not silently enter its total. Preserve earlier infobases. The ready-made report requires no BSL.

sections.title: A filled field must have the intended meaning
paragraphs: A request links a customer, service, duration and work status. A visible customer label alone does not establish a link to the intended record. Select through the list and check its code. Do not create a duplicate just because a search hides the original; clear the search first.

Field types and business rules are separate. A numeric field does not make every number an acceptable duration. Our original training document permits 0 through 1440 minutes inclusive and requires a customer, service and status. These are this configuration’s rules, not universal rules of every 1C application.

sections.title: Reason before acting
paragraphs: Change this new form’s input, not validation code or an older request.
Identify the infobase, list and particular record separately. A command, visible text and saved state are different things.

code.source: New request: 30 minutes, Новая, no customer/service → Записать → prompt → select existing records → Записать.

paragraphs: Change this new form’s input, not validation code or an older request.

tables.caption: A missing link and a meaningful correction

sections.title: A rejection asks you to correct the form
paragraphs: Записать triggers validation and document rules. Missing customer or service produces a prompt to select them; a missing status produces its own prompt; an out-of-range duration produces the 0..1440 message. Clicking the button alone is not a successful write.

Keep the new form open, read the reason and correct the relevant field. Do not select a random record merely to remove the message. If the result is unclear, record your steps and observation. Do not alter validation code to bypass a rejected input.

sections.title: Predict the result
paragraphs: 1441 minutes were refused. May you remove the check to finish the exercise?

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. This service permits 0..1440 inclusive. Correct the value rather than removing the rule. Distinguish refusal from a successful save, then reopen the valid request.

sections.title: Boundaries explain the rule
paragraphs: Compare ordinary input 30, permitted boundaries 0 and 1440, and invalid -1 and 1441. Zero is explicitly known zero effort here, not an unknown duration. A different organization may require a strictly positive duration; learn its rule instead of transferring this one automatically.

Use a new separate request for invalid-input experiments, preserving accepted records. Confirm that the invalid value did not enter the saved list. If the field rejects a value before writing, record that earlier input constraint; do not disable it to force the experiment.

sections.title: Context and transitions
paragraphs: Read the path and explain what changes at each step. The diagram does not operate the external application.

sections.title: Check the explanation’s boundary
paragraphs: Missing required links and minutes outside 0..1440 must not count as successful writes; do not disable validation.
Read feedback, correct the form, wait for the write and reopen your number.

sections.title: Reopening verifies persistence
paragraphs: After correcting the form click Записать, wait for completion and record its actual number. Close it, locate that number, reopen and compare customer, service, minutes and status. This distinguishes stored data from an unsaved form.

Writing and posting are different actions. Posting is disabled in the initial training configuration; ВРаботе is a field value, not a posting indicator. A Nexus self-report is separate from the installed infobase: it neither creates a 1C request nor proves server grading.

sections.title: A new independent task
paragraphs: In a separate new form in your own training infobase select your customer and service. Enter 1441 minutes and New; expect refusal. Change only minutes to 25, save and reopen by your own number. Compare all fields with your prediction. Preserve earlier 20/55 and 30/45 requests. Check permitted boundaries 0/1440 separately from the report control set: additional saved records change its total.
Record a prediction first. After your own attempt reveal the reference and compare the selected record as well as its number.

sections.title: Actual training-service window
paragraphs: The author uses three new separate training infobases:control 4/120, a new 4/160 set and input validation. The actual report DCS and ordering/filter queries run; records are compared after restarting. Three GUI captures show only their labelled states. Complete manual form entry, every list setting, installer, permissions and learner actions are NOT RUN.

Technical checks do not assess understanding. Distinguish your observations from unperformed steps. Training names, numbers and comments are fictional; no work data is required.

selfcheck.prompt: 1441 minutes were refused. May you remove the check to finish the exercise?
selfcheck.feedback: No. This service permits 0..1440 inclusive. Correct the value rather than removing the rule. Distinguish refusal from a successful save, then reopen the valid request.

selfcheck.prompt: How do you verify a saved request?
options: Reopen your number and compare fields

selfcheck.prompt: What should you do for a missing customer?
options: Select the intended existing record and retry

selfcheck.prompt: What must you read after correcting 1441 to 25?
selfcheck.feedback: The new 1441 form did not become a saved request. Correcting it to 25 produced my actual number; closing and reopening reads the same customer, service, New status and 25 minutes. Earlier requests were not edited. This configuration permits 0 and 1440 and refuses -1 and 1441; if the UI blocks typing -1, record the early restriction rather than disabling it. This experiment establishes neither all input types nor another learner’s understanding.

selfcheck.prompt: How did you distinguish the selected record, unsaved input and saved result? Give your own observation and the check’s limit.
selfcheck.feedback: This free response is not graded automatically. Compare it with actual fields in your own infobase.

criteria: Name the own infobase, exact records and observations after reopening.
The new task preserves the worked example; only intended fields change.
An expected refusal is not reported as a successful save; unperformed steps are explicit.

steps.title: Predict refusal
steps.action: Select your existing cards, New and 1441 minutes. Record the expected refusal before Save.

steps.title: Read the message
steps.action: Try saving and read the reason. Change neither an old request nor validation code.
steps.expected: Refusal is not reported as a successful save.

steps.title: Correct and save
steps.action: Correct minutes to 25 and preserve other selected fields. Save, close and note the actual number.
steps.expected: A new valid request is saved.

steps.title: Read again
steps.action: Open your row and read 25 and all other fields. Distinguish refusal, correction and saved state in your note.
